title: Refuse raw invisible format characters in a brief
body: Outcome: krn brief check refuses a brief containing a raw invisible format character (U+FEFF after position 0, U+200B-U+200F, U+2028/2029, U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) and names its line. Evidence: PR #197 review attempt 1 prepass FAIL (2 BLOCKING): the lead's brief said '`<raw U+FEFF>` or `\\u{FEFF}`' because the escape text became a raw character while writing the file; the judges read the Settled decision as excluding the \\uFEFF escape. Proof: new observer under test/brief/ red at base by assertion.
